hook.name: ProbeFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a 1% (100 bps) fee on the native token side of ASSET/NATIVE pool swaps by taking deltas in beforeSwap (buy direction) and afterSwap (sell direction), accumulating revenue in the contract for the owner to flush to a configurable treasury address. Only supports exact-input swaps on pools pairing a fixed ASSET with native ETH.
